name: (03) Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Quills of the Earth

system.description: You cause huge spikes to shoot out of walls, ceilings, and floors, made of the same material as the surface from which they form - especially dangerous to vampires in a wooden house or room. This is treated as a ranged attack, requiring a challenge of your Mental Traits versus the target's Physical Traits. A successful attack inflicts two levels of nonaggravated damage. Wooden spikes damaging a Kindred require a single Simple Test to determine if the target has been staked. Because of the size of the spikes, only one Simple Test is needed, and Potence cannot be used in the initiating challenge since it is not a physical test of strength.
